auditReason: Site Stats owns a shared metrics collector rather than a UI. Marketplace evidence must capture its real series through a consuming Core metrics dashboard.

entries.title: Site Stats content totals in the Core metrics dashboard.
entries.notes: Capture from a consuming Core metrics dashboard with capell-app/site-stats installed. Seed multiple UTC days of Core metric samples collected by ContentTotalsMetricsCollector so both content.pages_total and content.sites_total show non-flat, labelled trends. The dashboard is host-owned; do not describe it as a package-owned Site Stats UI and do not substitute generic hero or catalogue artwork.
entries.useCase: An administrator verifies that the installed Site Stats collector supplies page and site inventory history to Capell's shared metrics dashboard.

notes: The contract requires authentic integration evidence. No screenshot is claimed until the runner captures the seeded consuming dashboard and writes the declared output file.
